title: One workflow tightens all governance prose in every repo, and binds prose to the code it describes
why: Owner chat Nov 3 19:25-19:30 CST: a full Sonnet workflow with Opus judges at the end, for all repos, "similar vibe to the run1 run2 audit of alignment"; scope is "any prose governance, rules (pointers) pulled into repos like their decisions, etc", not CLAUDE.md alone; it should also "develop the whole pointer/reference system ... to ensure our code is good at properly editing out all parts that touch or affect a piece of prose and vice versa". Run in its own session that the coordinator starts, not in triage.
note:
Nov 6 11:47 CST (coordinator): step stale-prose-standing merged here; its done check (the rule_mechanisms row for speak-rewrite-superseded-in-place) is met by this lane's STALE005. The lane goes ahead on four parts: one home for outside facts (route rows), a report-only STALE005 lint, falsifiers in refusal_note and report_guard, and a model judge at merge (report-only until measured).
From stale-prose-standing: shiv, Nov 1 16:30 CST, in chat to triage: "Please make it a standing thing that stale prose never makes it anymore man when things change the prose needs to be snappy to match (i think maybe we've already addressed this and we just had a past debt of this -- unclear)". Incident the same hour: a question's 'Departs from' line described main wrongly (owner, 16:23 CST).
Nov 6 11:37 CST (coordinator): lane started, session_013NEJL32AmBg2eZnNkXRFQK; no live lane since Nov 3. Owner 11:36 CST: an unbacked definitive claim anywhere in prose, not only about GitHub, needs a backing and a check.
Scope: CLAUDE.md, .claude/rules, docs/decisions, docs/rules, debts, skills and output style text in claude-settings, q_max, mailaudit, degen, joyous, home, ios-adblock and banchi (banchi CLAUDE.md stays with lane banchi-claude-md-cut). Parts: (1) the content check (page item 224 pick a: judge content, count bytes, cite the docs figure as a pointer; home decision claude-md-shrink); (2) per-repo cuts on draft PRs: restated parent rules become cites, folder-only text becomes path rules, stale text is fixed; (3) the pointer system: a change to code, a constant or a path finds each prose line that names it, and a change to a prose rule finds the code and checks that hold it. Builds on step stale-prose-standing (lane session_013NEJL29WWWGpGKkCXuFwhb, Nov 1) and step drift-audit-lanes; the new session reads both first. Inputs: 8 Opus audits in triage scratchpad /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/f60ae040-bcc1-59c6-a510-bc946ee428bc/scratchpad/audits/. The Opus judges need the owner's typed override in that session (guard agent-role-model). Opus grant: the owner's 19:25 CST words are on this step for the judge role (reviewer); judges as Explore pass with an `Audit:` first line written as fixed text. The coordinator sets `lane` to the new session's id when it starts it.

grants.words: yeah approved send a full sonnet workflow through that with some opus judges toward the end of the workflow for the more judgement related parts on this
